title: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent

entities.name: Rat
entities.description: A small, Gateless Gruul-born thief and daughter of Gan Shokta who grieves Hekara while fighting Eternals alongside Kaya and Teyo.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A young Shieldmage acolyte and new planeswalker who defends his allies with light shields and has never killed anything but a spider.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: The Orzhov guildmaster and planeswalker who leads Rat and Teyo toward Orzhova to rally her guild; she has been guildmaster only weeks.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: Rat's best friend, a Rakdos emissary, who is dead.

entities.name: Gan Shokta
entities.description: Rat's father, a stern Gruul warrior who rejects Domri's leadership and returns to Borborygmos.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: The new Gruul guildmaster and planeswalker who decides to ally with Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: The previous Gruul guildmaster whom Gan Shokta respects.

entities.name: Govan Radley
entities.description: An ogre Gruul warrior in Domri's pack.

entities.name: Bombop
entities.description: An ogre Gruul warrior who is killed by Eternals while charging ahead.

entities.name: Akamal Cray
entities.description: A Gruul warrior in the pack.

entities.name: Sheeza and Jahdeera
entities.description: Viashino twin Gruul warriors in the pack.

entities.name: Vorel
entities.description: The Simic biomancer who leads terraformers, super-soldiers and merfolk against the Dreadhorde.

entities.name: Maree
entities.description: A goblin chamberlain, second-in-command to Zarek, who leads Izzet mech-mages.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk planeswalker from Zendikar who joins the pack.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A young human planeswalker from Amonkhet who names the Eternals she kills, whom she once knew.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: An armored short planeswalker with a braided ponytail who joins the battle.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A tall planeswalker in a gold-filigreed dress who releases a golden hummingbird that kills Eternals.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: A planeswalker with long blonde hair and a crook-staff who enthralls an Eternal; Rat gets her name wrong.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: The Izzet guildmaster whose Beacon summoned the planeswalkers.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker who mind-calls everyone to retreat to the Azorius Senate.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who orders the group to split up and rally others.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A planeswalker who comments that not all planeswalkers are Gatewatch material.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who healed Teyo's cut.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker leading the invasion with Eternals and God-Eternals.

entities.name: The Eternals
entities.description: Undead lazotep-covered soldiers of Bolas that roam Ravnica killing everyone outside buildings.

entities.name: God-Eternals
entities.description: Four immense Eternals, once Amonkhet's gods, killed by Bolas and now his servants, who tear apart Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The guild of clans whose warriors, led by Domri, fight Eternals and then partly join Bolas.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The biomancer guild whose forces join the pack.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild of mech-mages whose forces join the pack.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The guild Kaya leads and wants to muster.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A league of planeswalkers who oppose major threats across the Multiverse.

entities.name: Shieldmage Order
entities.description: Teyo's monastic order from Gobakhan.

entities.name: Cathedral Opulent
entities.description: The Orzhov cathedral and guildhall Kaya seeks.

entities.name: Krumnen's
entities.description: A speakeasy at the end of a dead-end alley with a heavy iron door.

entities.name: Tenth District Plaza
entities.description: The plaza where the portal and God-Eternals appear.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnyan world tree, torn apart by God-Eternals in the plaza.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The meeting place Jace calls the planeswalkers and guildmasters to.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane under siege.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Kiora's home plane.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: Samut's home plane, from which the Eternals originally came.

events.summary: Rat, stunned by news of Hekara's death, stabs an Eternal about to kill Teyo, and Kaya takes Rat and Teyo with her.
events.quote: Furious, I leapt at it and stabbed it in the eyes.

events.summary: Gideon Jura tells the planeswalkers to split up through the city to save people and rally others, and Kaya recruits Rat and Teyo.
events.quote: We need to split up. Spread out through the city.

events.summary: Kaya leads Rat and Teyo across Ravnica toward Orzhova, saving people and telling them to shelter indoors, since Eternals do not enter buildings.
events.quote: The saving grace was that, for whatever reason, the Eternals weren't entering any of the buildings.

events.summary: Teyo, Kaya and Rat discuss the Gatewatch and Teyo admits he has killed only a spider.
Kaya's shortcut leads to a dead end, and Rat reveals the alley is a dead end as Eternals enter it.
events.quote: Another crop of Eternals had entered the mouth of the alley.

events.summary: Teyo expands his shield across the alley to hold the Eternals while Rat picks the lock of Krumnen's.
Gruul warriors led by Domri Rade charge the Eternals from behind and save the trio.
events.quote: attacked the Eternals from behind, axes chopping through lazotep.

events.summary: Teyo and Kaya save Gan Shokta from a dying Eternal, and Rat reveals Gan is her father.
The Gruul, Izzet and Simic forces fight together, and the group meets planeswalkers Kiora and Samut, who frees dead Eternals by name.
Gruul, Simic and Izzet storm a hill together, and Huatli, Saheeli Rai and Kasmina join; Bombop and a Simic shaman are killed.
events.quote: Poor Bombop rushed in too far ahead of the rest of us.

events.summary: Four God-Eternals emerge from the portal over Tenth District Plaza, and Samut identifies them as her plane's gods, now Bolas's servants.
The God-Eternals tear apart Vitu-Ghazi, and Domri cheers and announces the Gruul will join the dragon.
Gan Shokta refuses to follow Domri and goes back to Borborygmos, and Domri leads others to the plaza.
A viashino planeswalker is killed by an Eternal that drains his life force, and the fire shoots toward Bolas.
events.quote: Then that fire rocketed into the air, shooting like a comet toward Tenth District Plaza and the dragon.

events.summary: Jace mind-calls everyone to retreat and meet at the Azorius Senate.
events.quote: Meet us at the Azorius Senate. Now.

relations.note: He has replaced Borborygmos as guildmaster.
relations.quote: I still couldn't believe he had replaced a fine warrior like Borborygmos as Gruul's new guildmaster.

relations.note: Guildmaster for a matter of weeks.
relations.quote: Rat, I've been guildmaster for a matter of weeks.
led by his second-in-command, Chamberlain Maree.

relations.note: Leads the Simic forces in the battle.
relations.quote: Terraformers, super-soldiers, and merfolk led by Biomancer Vorel.

relations.note: Domri decides to join Bolas, which Gan Shokta rejects.

relations.quote: I wasn't going to leave him alone to die like I had Hekara

relations.note: She fights Eternals she once knew.
relations.quote: knew them I guess from when they were her friends.
